context.conventions: App Router, Server Components by default, Client Components with 'use client', API routes in app/api/

developer.extra_instructions: Prefer Server Components. Use 'use client' only when needed (interactivity, hooks, browser APIs). Use Server Actions for mutations. Follow Next.js data fetching patterns.

tester.extra_instructions: Test Server Components with integration tests. Test Client Components with React Testing Library. Test API routes with supertest or fetch mocking.
